title: Akbar’s painters illustrate the Hamzanama
summary: A surviving Hamzanama folio from Akbar’s monumental illustrated project depicts the spy Zambur bringing Mahiya to Tawariq.

citations.locator: Object 23.264.1; Date, artist attributions and project description
citations.note: Supports the linked claims within the stated date and attribution limits.

claims.text: A surviving Hamzanama folio from Akbar’s monumental illustrated project depicts the spy Zambur bringing Mahiya to Tawariq.
About 1570 dates this surviving folio, not the start or completion of the entire Hamzanama project.
Large paintings accompanied storytelling, with text on their reverse. The Met attributes this folio to Kesav Das and Mah Muhammad rather than identifying either artist with certainty.

review.corroboration: The Met catalogue’s folio date, artist attributions and project description were inspected. The full project chronology was not independently established.
